title: issue-item@v1
description: Normalized frontmatter object for a single issues/.../index.md item, applied AFTER strict YAML front-matter parsing (docs/pipeline/issue-yaml-profile.md) and Markdown-body validation (docs/pipeline/issue-store.md #11). Schema success never substitutes for those checks.

schema_version.description: Extension/version negotiation. Consumers must reject unknown major versions and may ignore unknown fields only within the SAME declared version (this document defines closed-object behavior for v1 itself; forward-compat is a consumer contract, not a schema loophole).

id.description: Must exactly match the ID derived from the file path (issue-store.md #3).

level.description: Must match the hierarchy depth implied by id/path.

parent.description: Required for level=task|subtask; forbidden for level=feature. Must exactly match the parent ID derived from the path.

state.description: Lifecycle state token; full lifecycle semantics defined in docs/pipeline/issue-lifecycle.md (Task 0037-03.01). This schema only fixes the closed enum.

visibility.description: Publication class (issue-store.md #6). Missing field defaults to internal at the application layer; this schema still requires it be explicit and valid whenever present.

created_at.description: Timestamps are always strings (quoted per issue-yaml-profile.md #5), never native YAML timestamp type.

prerequisites.description: List of PREREQ edges pointing at other item IDs. Self-reference is invalid (checked by the fixture runner; JSON Schema alone cannot express self != id).

work_type.description: Closed enum of the kind of work this item represents.

origin.description: Where this item's identity originated, for provenance/migration traceability.

source.description: Locator string, e.g. legacy-todo-md#L108 or an item id for split/merge origins.

relations.description: Non-prerequisite typed edges to other items (e.g. supersedes, derived-from, blocks).

authority.description: Whether this item's index.md is currently authoritative or shadow-only (issue-store.md #8, cutover-gated).

criteria.description: Structured mirror of the ## Acceptance criteria Markdown list (issue-store.md #11.4), for machine consumption. The Markdown body remains the human-readable source of truth; this array must stay consistent with it (checked by the fixture runner, not expressible in JSON Schema alone).

limits.description: Optional per-item override of global size/depth limits (issue-yaml-profile.md #4); absence means the global defaults apply.
